Transport Modes

Cadena para nieve

A traction device consisting of metal links fitted around the tires of trucks, trailers, or other road vehicles to improve grip on snow and ice, required by road transport regulations in winter conditions.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Cadena para nieve?

In this glossary, Cadena para nieve refers to: A traction device consisting of metal links fitted around the tires of trucks, trailers, or other road vehicles to improve grip on snow and ice, required by road transport regulations in winter conditions.

How is Cadena para nieve used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Las cadenas para nieve deben colocarse en los ejes motrices cuando así lo indiquen las señales de tráfico o la normativa invernal local."

Why does Cadena para nieve matter in logistics?

Cadena para nieve matters because it supports clear communication in Transport Modes contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Cadena para nieve?

Cadena para nieve is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A traction device consisting of metal links fitted around the tires of trucks, trailers, or other road vehicles to improve grip on snow and ice, required by road transport regulations in winter conditions.

Operational example

Snow chains must be installed on drive axles when indicated by road signs or local winter regulations.

Localized term

Cadena para nieve

Localized example
